msg_subject_1: their room photo, your tile in it
msg_body_1:
Hello Frederic,

41zero42.com shows the collections well, and then the visit ends at a catalogue.

What it can't do is show somebody your product in the room they are standing in. So they look, make their mind up and go, and you never find out who they were.

Showhouse does that on your own site. They take a photo of the room, your product appears in it and nothing else in the picture moves, and the image unlocks when they confirm their email.

Try it on a photo of your own room: https://www.tryshowhouse.com/tile

Want me to load some 41Zero42 products in first?
msg_subject_2: what one of these looks like when it lands
msg_body_2:
Hello Frederic,

Rather than describe it, here's a lead as it actually arrives.

One record, four things in it:

a photo of their actual room with your product in it
their own words, something like "large format warm travertine, wide plank, matte"
the spec: herringbone, Carrara and cream, polished, 600x300
and an email address they've confirmed

That's someone who has already decided, sitting in your inbox with a picture of the room attached. Not a name on a mailing list.

https://www.tryshowhouse.com/tile

Want me to put 41Zero42 products in one so you can see yours?
msg_subject_3: judge it yourself rather than take my word
msg_body_3:
Hello Frederic,

The usual reason this goes nowhere isn't that people dislike the idea. It's that it sounds like a project, and nobody has a spare quarter to give it.

It isn't one. We do the catalogue work, it goes up under your name, and your side of it is mostly telling us which collections matter.

Have a look at the studio first and see if it's even worth the conversation: https://www.tryshowhouse.com/tile

And if it isn't, tell me and I'll stop.
